replaces: The whiteface clown head (2026-10-12, archive/2026-10-12-clown-logo/), which had replaced the shaded tent icon of 2026-10-08.

pixellab.description: Pixel art app icon of a circus big top tent, three-quarter view: a broad striped conical roof in alternating white and slate panels, a short pole on top with a little pennant flag, a scalloped valance around the roof's edge, striped walls, and a dark open entrance at the left front with its curtains tied back. Redrawn in the 1928 steamboat rubber-hose cartoon style of the style image: thick near-black navy outline around every shape, bold simple rounded shapes, a glossy white highlight on the roof, only five tones from near-black navy through slate blue-grey to white, centered and filling the frame, no ground, no shadow, no text.

referenceImage.usage: The circus tent to draw: keep its three-quarter view, striped conical roof, pennant on the top pole, scalloped valance and the left-front entrance with tied-back curtains.
referenceImage.what: The Home tent at the time, tent-bigtop-pixellab-source.png (tent-bigtop.json, PixelLab Pro Flash, seed 26100201; both in archive/2026-10-12-tent-before-logo/ since Home took this logo's tent, tent-home.json), scaled 4x with nearest-neighbour to 384x384.

styleImage.usage: AgentLand's clown logo sprite, drawn in the 1928 steamboat rubber-hose cartoon style: match its thick dark outline, bold simple shapes, pixel scale, glossy highlights and five-tone navy-to-white palette.
styleImage.what: The clown logo sprite it replaced, archive/2026-10-12-clown-logo/clown-logo-pixellab-source.png (96x96).

menuBar.what: The Mac menu-bar template, drawn by hand pixel by pixel for the bar's 1x grid, not resampled from the sprite: a 21x19 glyph of the tent's dome, scalloped valance and curtains with a round door (study variant M4b).
menuBar.colour: black (a template image: the bar paints it, white in Dark, so the tent reads mostly white)
menuBar.why: The owner's Mac draws the bar at 1x (1920x1080) in Dark. The clown sprite, resampled to the bar's 22 pt, turned to anti-aliased grey mush; a glyph made for the grid stays crisp. Study: the owner's local evidence, .evidence/icon-redesign-20261012/menubar-study/README.md.

packaging: scripts/package-logo.py: each opaque pixel takes the nearest of the riders' five day tones (weights 0.3, 0.59, 0.11, clown-ride.json palette.day). App icon of iPhone, iPad and Mac (ios/AgentLand/AppIcon.icon, Icon Composer, iOS 27 glass; owner 2026-10-17, design 'B: tent 7x'): icon.json with a glass group 'Tent' (specular, neutral shadow 0.5, translucency off) over a group 'Background' without glass, supported-platforms squares shared. Assets/tent.png: the day tones (palette.day), cropped to the sprite's pixels (101x100), x7 with nearest-neighbour, centred in a clear 1024x1024 canvas and moved down 8 px; Assets/tent-mono.png, its 'tinted' specialization for Clear and Tinted: the same with one grey per tone from the day tones' luminance (>230 255, >140 205, >90 140, >40 80, else 28); Assets/bg.png: opaque, a vertical gradient from #3D4A5C to #222B37 (an image, since ictool 27 ignores a fill's dark specialization). In-app mark (Resources/LogoMark.png): the day tones cropped to the sprite's pixels and padded with clear pixels to a centred 101x101 square. Menu-bar template: tent-menubar.txt in black with its alpha levels, the glyph at x 0, y 2 of a clear 22x22 canvas (Resources/LogoMenuBar.png), and that image doubled with nearest-neighbour (Resources/LogoMenuBar-2x.png, 44x44); AgentLandMenuBarIcon shows them as the 1x and 2x bitmaps of one 22-pt template image, never resampled. Previews: branding/logo-light.png (day on white) and logo-dark.png (night on slate), fitting 76% of 512.
